ody.text: Ixidor and Nivea make a living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights in Aphetto, until Phage kills Nivea and Ixidor loses his fame and fortune.
Banished to a desert for failing to pay his debts, he discovers he can create real things and builds an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal in revenge.
When the Cabal attacks his fortress, a deathwurm representing Nivea's death consumes him, and Akroma finds him living in the wurm, worshipping an image of Nivea, restoring her but refusing to return.
Kamahl later kills the wurm in Topos, freeing Ixidor, but he is possessed by Lowallyn, and his life ends when Karona kills Lowallyn in the final battle.

ons.text: Heartbroken and abandoned in the desert over gambling debts, Ixidor shapes Akroma from his dream at the cost of his right arm, charging her to avenge Nivea, and declares that reality has exiled him.
He builds the kingdom of Topos, and the angel carries out his will, since he has only to imagine his enemies' ruin and Akroma makes it so.
In the Nightmare War, Phage releases deathwurms born of her murders, and even Akroma cannot stop them.
Ixidor flees with his unmen, but some betray him and a deathwurm devours him.

lgn.text: Akroma spreads Ixidor's message, effectively founding a religion around him, but the joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos, and Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone.
Inside the deathwurm, Akroma finds Ixidor, who heals her and shows her the way out, though he wishes to stay with Nivea's spirit.
